title: Maria Farmer mural showing Epstein in a flying saucer on an FBI antenna
summary: Jay Anderson tells of Maria Farmer mural showing Epstein in a flying saucer on an FBI antenna, about unspecified at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Gain Maxwell's depicted as a dragon biting a child in half it's all very nasty stuff and then there's also a a an antenna going up with an FBI flag on it with a flying saucer hanging off the top of it with Epstein's face inside the window.

plain: A guest named Jay Anderson, on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, describes a mural called The Elite by the artist Maria Farmer. According to Anderson, it shows Ghislaine Maxwell, the close associate of the financier Jeffrey Epstein, as a dragon biting a child in half, and an antenna flying a flag of the FBI, the US federal police agency, with a flying saucer hanging off the top and Epstein's face in its window. Anderson raises it because it seems to link Epstein, the government and UFOs in one picture.
